# Maba Suitez

> Current project information and enquiry website for Maba Suitez on Jalan Hang Jebat, Kuala Lumpur, beside the Merdeka 118 precinct.

Last updated: 2026-10-03
Canonical website: https://themabasuitez.com/

## Confirmed project summary

- Development: Maba Suitez
- Developer: EXSIM MABA Sdn Bhd
- Location: Jalan Hang Jebat, 50150 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Land area: 1.328 acres
- Configuration: Two towers, 914 total units
- Type A: 323 sq ft office suite
- Type B: 484sqft 1+1, one bathroom
- Type C and C(M): 657 sq ft dual-key suite, one room, two bathrooms
- Parking: 391 car park bays; not included with units
- Maintenance: RM0.99 per sq ft including sinking fund, based on current supplied material
- Schedule: 60 months from APDL, based on current supplied material
- Rail: Approximately 160 metres to MRT Merdeka according to the supplied location diagram
- Precinct: Beside the Merdeka 118 precinct and Menara Merdeka Maybank

## Important qualification

Prices, unit availability, rebates, packages, booking terms, APDL details, completion dates, specifications, furnishing, operator appointment and management programme terms must be confirmed with the appointed sales team and official developer documents. No rental yield or capital appreciation is guaranteed.
